**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- **What I checked:** full-text searches for "liquidated damages", "termination fee", "penalty", "remaining contract value", "shall pay"; the termination and post-termination sections (§§ 9.1–9.5, 10.1–10.2), fees/disputes (§§ 7.1–7.5), liability (§§ 21.1–21.4), audit (§§ 22.1–22.3), and force majeure (§ 27.3).
- **Result:** No liquidated damages, stipulated penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee charge is payable by Juniper Ridge. § 27.3 in fact lets us terminate "without penalty" with a prepaid-fee refund, and § 10.2 runs refunds in our favour. This sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
- **Noted, not flagged:** § 2.1's USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment is the closest economic exposure but is a minimum-commitment term reviewed under MINCOMMIT — not double-flagged here. § 22.2's audit cost-shifting is reimbursement of actual costs plus the undisputed shortfall (and only above a 5% underpayment threshold), not a stipulated damages amount.
